key.name: style
key.description: depth: the three-finger swipe up (and the overview) uses the Depth and parallax motion. stock: GNOME's own overview motion, exactly as without this extension. Takes effect at the next overview (or at once if the overview is open).

key.name: piles
key.summary: Vitre Stage piles in the overview
key.description: stay (default): the Vitre Stage piles stay on the left, fanned open, until the overview closes (the concept's behaviour); needs the Vitre Stage extension (this extension wraps four of its methods while the overview is in use, it does not edit it) and behaves like carry without it. carry: the parked windows fly from the rail into the overview grid (Stage's own overview hand-off).
